research_question: Within the declared finite context grid, does an explicit context-indexed epsilon_a,C produce reproducible admissibility classifications across fixed seeds and contexts?
hypothesis: H1: classifications are reproducible when the threshold is materialized in the context and the comparison rule is fixed. H0: classifications vary silently across equivalent contexts or require an implicit global threshold.

independent_variables.name: epsilon_a_C
independent_variables.definition: Positive threshold materialized by the context

independent_variables.name: seed
independent_variables.definition: Deterministic seed for generated bounded distinction values

dependent_variables.name: admissibility_classification
dependent_variables.definition: ADMISSIBLE iff value > epsilon_a,C; otherwise UNDEFINED_INADMISSIBLE

dependent_variables.name: classification_reproducibility
dependent_variables.definition: Agreement of repeated deterministic evaluations under identical context and seed

dependent_variables.name: threshold_sensitivity
dependent_variables.definition: Classification change under declared context threshold changes with value and seed held fixed

controls.name: primitive_law
controls.purpose: Prevent threshold study from changing RT_core
controls.implementation: No primitive or continuation rule is modified by the notebook.

controls.name: comparison_rule
controls.implementation: Use strict value > epsilon_a,C for every context.

controls.name: seed_replay
controls.implementation: Repeat every declared seed/context pair without changing generated values.

controls.name: context_materialization
controls.implementation: Carry context id and threshold in every output row.

random_seed.derivation_policy: Fixed before execution; no undeclared seeds.

termination_conditions: All context/seed combinations and both replay passes complete.
A missing context field or undeclared threshold is detected.
No post-hoc expansion of contexts, seeds, or generated-value count.

decision_rules: Support only bounded reproducibility inside the declared grid if all replay classifications agree.
Report threshold sensitivity as an observation, not a causal or universal law.
Any hidden-threshold or replay mismatch is a limitation and blocks positive interpretation.
allowed_interpretations: Bounded context-indexed threshold behavior in the declared notebook domain.

immutability.supersession_policy: Do not edit after execution starts; create a new spec_id for changes.
